competences.description: Throws ninja stars to attack and inflicts Continuous Damage for 1 turn. This attack will deal more damage according to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Inflicts great damage by slashing the enemy with the energy of the sword and absorbs the enemy's Attack Bar by 50%. The damage of this skill increases according to the Attack Speed.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Blows up a ray of light to inflict damage 2 times to all enemies. The first attack removes one beneficial effect each from enemies with a 50% chance, and the second attack increases the enemy's chances of landing a Glancing Hit for 3 turns with a 75% chance.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
